scenes.text: Identify, explain and apply the important ideas behind sketch a simple community map.
Map: shows positions and places in an area. Symbol: stands for a place or feature.
Key: explains what map symbols mean. Direction: helps describe where to move. Scale: shows the relation between map distance and real distance.
Collect a few harmless facts about classroom materials, NOT personal details. Make a paper chart with the terms Map, Symbol and Key; explain what each means.
